text: grep -n "__rt_fpassthru\|__rt_fread\|4096\|chunk" src/codegen_support/runtime/io/readfile_wrapper.rs | head -14:  40: // [sp,#32] current chunk pointer (across the per-chunk release). 61: emitter.instruction("mov x1, #4096"); // request up to 4096 bytes 62: emitter.instruction("bl __rt_fread"); // x1 = chunk ptr, x2 = len 64: emitter.instruction("str x1, [sp, #32]"); // save the chunk ptr for the later release 66: emitter.instruction("add x9, x9, x2"); // add this chunk's length 69: emitter.instruction("ldr x0, [sp, #32]"); // reload the chunk ptr 70: emitter.instruction("bl __rt_decref_any"); // release the owned chunk, then loop 71: emitter.instruction("b __rt_rfw_loop"); // stream the next chunk 74: emitter.instruction("mov x0, x1"); // the final (empty/uncopied) owned chunk 98: // Frame: [rbp-8] fd, [rbp-16] byte count, [rbp-24] current chunk pointer. 102: emitter.instruction("sub rsp, 48"); // spill slots for fd/total/chunk 120: emitter.instruction("mov rsi, 4096"); // request up to 4096 bytes
